deviations.baseline_behavior: AST nodes carry mutable compiler caches (TupleIndex, RuntimeUsingIndex, TypeDefinitionAst.Type) and implement compile-time assignment protocols (ISupportsAssignment/IAssignableValue).
deviations.proposed_behavior: AST stays purely syntactic; slot indexes and assignment code generation live in compiler side tables keyed by node.
deviations.benefit: Immutable shareable trees; clean separation of parser and compiler; easier tooling reuse.
deviations.compatibility_cost: None observable by scripts; internal refactor only.
